title: 第十一章 超青藏高原59第十一章 超青藏高原60
lines: 四十九、青青草原离开核晶世界后，三位勇者被传送阵送回神迹大陆。
前方是一片被灰白色光幕笼罩的草原，光幕呈球形，将整片草原笼罩在内，表面流转着密集的封印纹路。
纹路层层嵌套，从地面一直延伸到天空，每一道纹路都泛着冷冽的寒光——那是宇宙级封印，将青青草原与外界彻底隔绝。
杨欣颖低头看着手腕上的召唤器。灰白色的石质仍包裹着召唤器表面，冰蓝光芒在石质深处微弱地跳动。
但她的召唤器中还多了另一样东西——两份核晶力量。那是从中华科技次元之核晶少年世界与韩国科技次元之核晶少年世界中释放出来的纯粹科技能量，由钶龙族创造、由乐宝和力奥守护、由飞凡和无限勇士共同重聚。
两份核晶力量，正是力之勇者新力量的一半。
“封印必须先解除。”唐琼凯停住脚步，全息界面在他视觉中展开，
“封印表面有筛选机制——只有科技自然眷顾之人才能进入。但筛选机制在封印解除之前不会启动。封印不解除，任何人都进不去，包括力之勇者。而解除封印的关键，就是核晶力量。两份核晶力量在你手中——只有你能解除封印，也只有你能进入青青草原。我和黄雪婧进不去。”黄雪婧将智能脚环上的数据调出，核晶力量的频率与封印纹路的共振点已经标注清晰。
“去吧。我们在外面等你。”杨欣颖独自走向灰白色光幕。她抬起手腕，两份核晶力量从召唤器中释放出来——金色的核晶光纹在她掌心凝聚，那是钶龙科技的纯粹结晶，只要持有理论与图纸，这份力量就不会消亡。
核晶力量的光芒接触到封印光幕的瞬间，灰白色的封印纹路开始剧烈波动。
金色光纹沿着封印纹路蔓延开来，如同阳光融化冰层。纹路一层接一层地剥落，从天空到地面，封印阵的每一道纹路都在核晶力量的冲击下寸寸碎裂。
宇宙级封印解除了。灰白色光幕在杨欣颖面前完全消散，青青草原的全貌展现在她眼前。
草原青翠欲滴，一条清澈的小溪从草原中央蜿蜒流过。空气清新而温暖。
这里没有机油——只有草油、草与水果组成的食物。草原上散落着几座以木材与石料搭建的建筑，没有任何现代工业的痕迹。
青青草原原本就是神迹大陆的一部分，只是被宇宙级封印隔绝了太久。
杨欣颖迈入青青草原。身后，黄雪婧和唐琼凯守在草原边缘，封印已解除，但青青草原的特殊性仍在——只有科技自然眷顾之人才能进入，而杨欣颖正是那个人。
她手腕上的召唤器中，两份核晶力量已融入冰蓝光芒之中，成为力之勇者新力量的一半。
前方不远处，一棵巨大的古树下，几个身影正聚在一起。头上一撮卷曲的羊毛、戴着眼镜的羊族老者慢羊羊正低头研究着一张图纸。
他身旁站着几只年轻的羊——喜羊羊的脖颈上挂着一只铃铛，懒羊羊正靠在树根上打盹，美羊羊的羊角上扎着一对粉色蝴蝶结，暖羊羊安静地站在一旁，沸羊羊双臂抱在胸前。
另一侧，几只狼正站在树下。灰太狼戴着一顶破旧的黄色帽子，手中同样拿着一张画满机械结构草图的图纸。
红太狼站在他身旁，小灰灰拉着她的手。
“力之勇者。”慢羊羊抬起头，推了推鼻梁上的眼镜，声音苍老而温和，
“星魄队长们托付我的力量，该交给你了。这份力量，代表科技世界自然力量。青青草原没有机油，没有工厂——但科技不只是机器。科技是自然之道，是草木生长之理，是水流循行之律。这份力量从青青草原的每一株草、每一滴水中来，由我一辈子研究自然之道的成果凝聚而成。现在，它归你所有。”他伸出手。
一团柔和的绿色光芒从他掌心浮现，光芒中隐约可以看到草木生长的纹理、水流循行的轨迹、四季更替的规律。
那是最原始的科技——自然科技的具象化。绿色光团从慢羊羊手中飘出，融入杨欣颖的召唤器。
灰白色石质深处，冰蓝光芒与金色核晶光纹之间，多了一道极淡的绿色自然光纹。
“还有我。”灰太狼走上前，他将手中的图纸折好放入怀中，声音带着一丝自豪，
“星魄队长们托付我的力量，该交给你了。这份力量，代表科技世界概念力量。我是发明家，一辈子都在画图纸、做实验——虽然大多数时候抓不到羊，但我从来不放弃。概念是什么？概念是还没造出来的东西。是图纸上的线条，是脑海里的想法，是还没有变成现实的所有可能。这份力量从每一次失败中来，从每一张废弃的图纸中来，从每一次重新站起来中来。现在，它也归你。”他伸出手。
一团深沉而透彻的蓝色光芒从他掌心浮现，光芒中隐约可以看到无数图纸的线条在流转——那些图纸上的机械结构还没有造出来，但它们的可能性已经存在于光团之中。
那是最纯粹的科技——概念科技的具象化。蓝色光团从灰太狼手中飘出，融入杨欣颖的召唤器。
这两份力量不是核晶力量——慢羊羊与灰太狼都是发明家，他们托付的力量来自星魄队长，一份是科技自然力量，一份是科技概念力量。
加上之前的两份核晶力量，四道光芒在召唤器中交织融合。召唤器表面的灰白色石质开始出现裂纹。
裂纹从中心向四周扩散，冰蓝光芒从裂缝中喷涌而出。四道力量在召唤器中融合——核晶科技之力的金色光纹，科技自然力量的绿色光纹，科技概念力量的蓝色光纹，再加上地震龙本身的冰蓝核心。
完整的新力量在召唤器中凝聚成型。石化彻底解除。杨欣颖抬起手腕。
冰蓝光芒不再被灰白石质束缚，完整而明亮地在她召唤器中流转。她将召唤器对准前方的空地，地震龙破土而出。
冰蓝装甲在青青草原的日光下泛着比之前更加深邃的光泽，双钻急速旋转，发出沉稳有力的轰鸣。
四道光纹——金、绿、蓝、冰蓝——在它的装甲表面交织流动。杨欣颖站在地震龙内部的同步空间中，她做出握钻的动作，地震龙双手同步握紧双钻——动作行为同步。
与此同时，一道深青色的巨大身影从大地深处浮现。大象青牛本体——不是合体形态，而是圣机本体的原始形态。
它体型庞大，下身为大象，上身为青牛。四条象腿粗壮如柱，每踏一步都在草原上激起一圈微弱的土浪。
象鼻粗壮有力，鼻管内部隐约可以看到电磁脉冲的弧光在跳跃。两颗象牙从面甲两侧向前延伸，牙尖泛着冷冽的寒光。
脊背上方，青牛的肩背高高隆起，青牛尾与大象尾在身后缓缓摆动。大象青牛与地震龙不同——它尚未合体，没有同步空间。
杨欣颖与大象青牛之间是指挥关系。杨欣颖收回地震龙与大象青牛，转身走向草原边缘。
在青青草原内部不能展开战斗——这里是科技之力的传承之地，不是战场。
content_en:
49. After Qingqing Prairie left the nuclear crystal world, the three brave men were sent back to the Miracle Continent by the teleportation array.
Ahead is a grassland shrouded by a gray-white light curtain. The light curtain is spherical, covering the entire grassland, with dense seal patterns flowing on the surface.
The lines are nested layer by layer, extending from the ground to the sky, and each line is glowing with a cold light - it is a cosmic seal that completely isolates the Qingqing Grassland from the outside world.
Yang Xinying looked down at the summoner on her wrist. The gray-white stone still covers the surface of the summoner, and ice-blue light pulses faintly deep in the stone.
But there is another thing in her summoner - two core crystal powers. It was pure technological energy released from the nuclear crystal youth world of the Chinese technological dimension and the nuclear crystal juvenile world of the Korean technological dimension. It was created by the Cumlong clan, guarded by Lebao and Leo, and reunited by Feifan and the Infinite Warrior.
The two core crystal powers are exactly half of the Power Hero's new power.
"The seal must be lifted first." Tang Qiongkai stopped and the holographic interface unfolded in his vision.
"There is a screening mechanism on the surface of the seal - only those who are naturally favored by technology can enter. But the screening mechanism will not be activated until the seal is lifted. No one can enter until the seal is lifted, including the Hero of Power. And the key to lifting the seal is the power of nuclear crystals. The two nuclear crystal powers are in your hands - only you can lift the seal, and only you can enter the Qingqing Grassland. Huang Xuejing and I can't enter." Huang Xuejing called up the data on the smart anklet, and the resonance points of the nuclear crystal power and the seal lines were clearly marked.
"Go. We'll wait for you outside." Yang Xinying walked toward the gray-white light curtain alone. She raised her wrist, and two core crystal powers were released from the summoner - the golden core crystal light pattern condensed in her palm. It was the pure crystallization of Cumlong technology. As long as you hold the theory and blueprints, this power will not die.
The moment the light of nuclear crystal power came into contact with the sealing light curtain, the gray-white sealing lines began to fluctuate violently.
Golden light patterns spread along the seal lines, like sunlight melting ice. The lines peeled off layer by layer. From the sky to the ground, every line of the sealing array was shattered inch by inch under the impact of the nuclear power.
The cosmic seal has been lifted. The gray-white light curtain completely dissipated in front of Yang Xinying, and the entire green grassland was displayed before her eyes.
The grassland is verdant, and a clear stream meanders through the center of the grassland. The air is fresh and warm.
There's no motor oil here - just grass oil and a diet of grass and fruit. There are several buildings made of wood and stone scattered on the grassland, without any trace of modern industry.
Qingqing Grassland was originally part of the Miracle Continent, but it was isolated by a cosmic seal for too long.
Yang Xinying steps into the green grassland. Behind them, Huang Xuejing and Tang Qiongkai were guarding the edge of the grassland. The seal had been lifted, but the special nature of the Qingqing Grassland remained - only those blessed by technology and nature could enter, and Yang Xinying was exactly that person.
In the summoner on her wrist, two core crystal powers have been integrated into the ice blue light, becoming half of the new power of the Power Hero.
Not far ahead, under a huge ancient tree, several figures were gathering together. Manchu Yangyang, an old sheep tribe man with a tuft of curly wool on his head and glasses, is studying a drawing with his head down.
There were several young sheep standing next to him - the Pleasant Goat had a bell hanging on its neck, the Lazy Goat was taking a nap against the root of a tree, the Beautiful Goat had a pair of pink bows tied on its horns, the Warm Goat stood quietly aside, and the Boiling Goat had its arms folded in front of its chest.
On the other side, several wolves were standing under the tree. Big Big Wolf wore a shabby yellow hat and also held a drawing full of sketches of mechanical structures in his hand.
Red Wolf stood beside him, and Xiao Huihui held her hand.
"The brave man of strength." Slow Sheep Yang raised his head, pushed up the glasses on the bridge of his nose, his voice was old and gentle,
"It's time to hand over the power entrusted to me by the Star Soul Captains. This power represents the natural power of the technological world. There is no engine oil or factory in Qingqing Prairie - but technology is not just a machine. Technology is the way of nature, the principle of growth of grass and trees, and the law of water flow. This power comes from every blade of grass and every drop of water in Qingqing Prairie, and is condensed from the results of my lifelong study of the way of nature. Now, it belongs to you." He stretched out his hand.
A ball of soft green light emerged from his palm. In the light, you could vaguely see the texture of the growth of vegetation, the trajectory of water flow, and the laws of the changing seasons.
That is the most primitive technology - the embodiment of natural technology. A green light ball floated out from Slow Sheep's hand and merged into Yang Xinying's summoner.
Deep in the gray-white stone, between the icy blue light and the golden core crystal light pattern, there is an extremely light green natural light pattern.
"And me." Big Gray Wolf stepped forward, folded the drawings in his hands and put them into his arms, with a hint of pride in his voice.
"It's time to hand over the power entrusted to me by the Star Soul Captains to you. This power represents the power of concepts in the world of science and technology. I am an inventor, and I have been drawing drawings and doing experiments all my life - although I can't catch sheep most of the time, I never give up. What is a concept? A concept has not been created yet. What comes out is the lines on the drawing, the ideas in the mind, and all the possibilities that have not yet become reality. This strength comes from every failure, from every abandoned drawing, and from every time you stand up again. Now, it belongs to you." He stretched out his hand.
A deep and penetrating blue light emerged from his palm. In the light, the lines of countless drawings could be vaguely seen flowing - the mechanical structures on those drawings had not yet been created, but their possibilities already existed in the light group.
That is the purest technology - the embodiment of conceptual technology. A blue light ball floated out from Big Big Wolf's hand and merged into Yang Xinying's summoner.
These two powers are not nuclear crystal powers - Slow Sheep and Big Big Wolf are both inventors. The power entrusted to them comes from Captain Star Soul. One is the natural power of science and technology, and the other is the power of technological concepts.
Coupled with the previous two core crystal powers, four rays of light intertwined and fused in the summoner. The gray-white stone on the surface of the summoner began to crack.
The cracks spread from the center to the surroundings, and ice-blue light spurted out from the cracks. Four powers are integrated in the summoner - the golden light pattern of the power of nuclear crystal technology, the green light pattern of the natural power of technology, the blue light pattern of the conceptual power of technology, plus the ice blue core of the Earthquake Dragon itself.
Complete new powers take shape in the Summoner. The petrification is completely eliminated. Yang Xinying raised her wrist.
The ice-blue light was no longer bound by the gray-white stone, flowing completely and brightly through her summoner. She pointed the summoner at the open space in front of her, and the Earthquake Dragon broke out of the ground.
The ice blue armor glowed with a deeper luster than before under the sunlight of the green grassland, and the double diamonds rotated rapidly, making a steady and powerful roar.
Four light patterns—gold, green, blue, and ice blue—weave and flow on its armored surface. Yang Xinying stood in the synchronized space inside the Seismic Dragon. She made a gesture of holding a diamond, and the Seismic Dragon grasped the double diamonds with both hands simultaneously - the movements and behaviors were synchronized.
At the same time, a huge dark blue figure emerged from the depths of the earth. The main body of the Elephant and Green Ox is not the combined form, but the original form of the Holy Machine's main body.
It is huge in size, with the lower body of an elephant and the upper body of a green bull. The four elephant legs are as thick as pillars, and each step stirs up a weak wave of soil on the grassland.
The elephant trunk is thick and powerful, and the arc of electromagnetic pulse can be vaguely seen jumping inside the nose tube. Two ivory tusks extended forward from both sides of the visor, and the tips of the teeth glowed with a cold light.
Above the back, the shoulders of the green bull are bulging high, and the tail of the green bull and the tail of the elephant are slowly swinging behind it. The Elephant Blue Bull is different from the Seismosaurus - it has not yet been combined, and there is no synchronization space.
There is a commanding relationship between Yang Xinying and Elephant Qingniu. Yang Xinying took back the Earthquake Dragon and the Elephant Green Bull, then turned and walked towards the edge of the grassland.
Fighting cannot take place inside Qingqing Grassland - this is the place where the power of science and technology is inherited, not a battlefield.
